patch_summary: v632 with lam lowered to 0.05. Full-bank sweeps with the real implementation show the online-profiled bank wants the low end (lam 0.05 +1508 vs 0.1222 at 0.1 and +248 at 0.2) while the mirror is flat over 0.05-0.2 (+1874/+2041/+2082), and the harm elsewhere is monotone in lam (public_quantizer -106 at 0.05 vs -208 at 0.1). Low lam is therefore both best where it matters and safest.
